 Order

This is the second application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No.88/2022 registered at Police Station Sukhi Sevania, District Bhopal (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 366, 376, 34, 506 of IPC of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 20.04.2022.

The first application of applicant was dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file afresh after recording statement of prosecutrix vide order dated 19.09.2022 passed in MCRC. No.44662/2022.
2.
As per the prosecution story, the allegation against present applicant is of abducting and committing rape with the minor prosecutrix.
Therefore, offence has been registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 20.04.2022.
It is submitted that statement of prosecutrix has been recorded before the Trial Court.

Although he has not filed copy of statement on record but he fairly NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:43029 2 MCRC-20308-2025 submitted that in the Court statement, the prosecutrix has deposed against present applicant.
There is no criminal antecedents of applicant.
Charge sheet has been filed.
The conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and has submitted that at the time of incident, the age of prosecutrix was below 16 years.
The present applicant has committed rape with minor prosecutrix.

Hence, the applicant does not deserve grant Deepak Prajapati vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115620107/

sentences.text:
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.
6.
Looking to aforesaid facts and circumstances as well as age of prosecutrix, I am not inclined to grant bail to the applicant.
7. Accordingly, present MCRC stands dismissed.
8. Since applicant is under custody since 20.04.2022 and trial is not completed, learned Trial Court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously.

9. Learned trial Court is also directed to send the progress report of the trial in every month to the Principal District Judge (Inspection) Jabalpur through the concerned Principal District Judge,
District Bhopal.
10. Registry is directed to send a copy of this order immediately to the concerned Trial Court and Principal District Judge (Inspection) Jabalpur for necessary compliance.
